title: AuditX Alert Webhook Payload
description: JSON schema for AuditX security monitoring alerts delivered to PolyLance

alert_id.description: Unique idempotent identifier for this alert

contract_address.description: Target smart contract address on Polygon

chain.description: EVM Chain ID or network identifier (e.g. '137' or 'polygon-mainnet')

severity.description: Severity level of the detected security event

category.description: Classification category for the security threat

title.description: Concise human-readable summary of the alert

description.description: Detailed description and diagnostic context of the event

detected_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the security event was identified

tx_hash.description: On-chain transaction hash associated with the alert, if applicable
